verdict.rationale: ChatGPT's docs describe projects that organize related chats and give ChatGPT shared context. Local projects also give chats access to folders on your computer, which covers the files part of the story. Project-level shared instructions are not explicitly documented; the only instructions evidence is a global personal AGENTS.md in Codex, not a per-project setting. Missing for 10: explicit project-scoped shared instructions, documented file uploads to cloud projects, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can organize related chats and files into a project or space that shares context and instructions

citations.quote: Use a project to organize related chats and give ChatGPT the context it needs.
A local project gives chats access to one or more folders on your computer, such as a collection of source files or a codebase.
